Done. 4 paragraphs → 3 paragraphs:

- **Paragraph 1 (SC + CJT)**: Merged CJT content into SC paragraph. CJT introduced with 2 sentences, $K_\text{eff}$ bridges to the plateau explanation, correlated-error citations kept, ends with symbolic confirmation bias distinction.
- **Paragraph 2 (Neuro-symbolic + test-time)**: Merged two paragraphs. Three-paradigm distinction preserved concisely. Test-time methods listed with all citations but without per-method descriptions. QwQ/DeepSeek-R1 kept as citations only. Oracle controls and diagnostics close the paragraph.
- **Paragraph 3 (Positioning)**: Cut ~50%. Kept core differentiator (BR numbers), shuffle control distinction, removed redundant contribution restatement and the neuro-symbolic positive-results sentence (those citations already appear in paragraph 2).

All 40+ original citations preserved. No em-dashes. "Symbolic confirmation bias" and "Condorcet Jury Theorem" spelled out per abbreviation rules.
